lines.text: I used to say sorry for taking up the space
Sorry for the dreams I had written on my face
Sorry for the fire when they wanted something tame
But I’m done apologizing for the sound of my own name
I’m not here to shrink or play it small
I’m here to stand up ten feet tall
No apologies, this is who I am
No more shrinking to fit inside your plan
I’m loud, I’m bright, I’m taking up the light
No apologies — not tonight
They told me pretty girls should keep their voices soft
But soft never got me anywhere I wanted to get lost
So I’m raising up the volume on the truth I’ve found
If it makes you uncomfortable, that’s not my problem now
I’m not here to shrink or play it small
I’m here to stand up ten feet tall
No apologies, this is who I am
No more shrinking to fit inside your plan
I’m loud, I’m bright, I’m taking up the light
No apologies — not tonight
I’m not angry, I’m just finally awake
And I’m not going back to sleeping through my own mistakes
No apologies, this is who I am
No more shrinking to fit inside your plan
I’m loud, I’m bright, I’m taking up the light
No apologies — and I’m doing it right
